lines.en: label undeservedfuture16:
scene himamcdonalds1
: Mr. and Mrs. Arakawa — welcome back to Chateau de L’Himawari.
lines.zh: : Arakawa 先生、Arakawa 太太——欢迎回到 Chateau de L'Himawari。

lines.en: : Due to recent events, our primary location is subject to temporary closure and we’ve been forced to transition to a much less glamorous building for the time being.
lines.zh: : 由于近期事件，我们的主店暂时关闭，被迫暂时转移到一栋远没有那么华丽的建筑里。

lines.en: : Rest assured, however, our standard for quality has not changed. And we hope you’ll enjoy dining with us tonight just as much as you did last time.
lines.zh: : 不过请放心，我们的品质标准没有改变。希望你们今晚在这里用餐，能和上次一样愉快。

lines.en: : Oh no. I’m going to cry again.
lines.zh: : 不好。我又要哭了。

lines.en: : You already are.
lines.zh: : 你已经哭了。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds2
: I can’t help it, okay?! Just a few hours ago, I wouldn’t leave the rooftop and could barely even {i}look{/i} at her!
lines.zh: : 我忍不住，好吗？！就在几个小时前，我还不肯离开屋顶，甚至几乎不敢{i}看{/i}她！

lines.en: : But Hima-chan wasn’t offended at all and {i}now{/i} she’s making us dinner {i}again!{/i} She’s too good for this world! I need to starve myself to repent! I’m sorry, Hima-chan!
lines.zh: : 可 Hima 酱一点都没生气，{i}现在又{/i}在给我们做饭了！她太好了，不属于这个世界！我得绝食来赎罪！对不起，Hima 酱！

lines.en: : Miss, I must kindly ask you to stop yelling in the restaurant. Regardless of how awestruck you are in relation to my somewhat curious existence.
lines.zh: : 女士，我必须恳请你不要在餐厅里大喊大叫。无论你对我这略显奇特的存在有多么敬畏。

lines.en: : You’re going to have to kick me out then! I can’t hold it back this time!
lines.zh: : 那你只能把我赶出去了！这次我忍不住了！

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds3
: Are you sure this is how you want to spend your final moments, Himawari? Digging burger patties out of a McDonald’s freezer while we sit here and openly dread your imminent departure?
lines.zh: : 你确定这就是你想度过最后时光的方式吗，Himawari？从 McDonald's 的冰柜里挖汉堡肉饼，而我们坐在这儿，明摆着在为你的即将离去而难受？

lines.en: : Hey, {i}you’re{/i} the ones who are going to be stuck here in an unpredictable and chaotic counterfeit world. Plus, {i}I{/i} get to watch you whenever I want. Remember?
lines.zh: : 嘿，要被困在这个不可预测又混乱的伪造世界里的是{i}你们{/i}。再说，{i}我{/i}想看你们的时候随时都能看。记得吗？

lines.en: : Besides, you followed me around all day while I modified the brains of your loved ones in front of you. The {i}least{/i} I can do is make you dinner.
lines.zh: : 再说，你们跟着我跑了一整天，看着我在你们面前改造你们所爱之人的大脑。我{i}至少{/i}能为你们做顿饭。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds4
: Mom too, of course. Because, while she didn’t help me with work, she’s earned her weight in meat after shedding more tears today than I have ever seen her cry in all my years of existence.
lines.zh: : 妈妈当然也算。因为，虽然她没帮我干活，但她今天流的泪比我存在这么多年里见过的都多，光凭这个就够她吃回本了。

lines.en: : I’d rather you sit here and hug me until everything is over. I won’t be able to eat right now anyway.
lines.zh: : 我倒希望你坐在这儿抱着我，直到一切结束。反正我现在也吃不下去。

lines.en: : I will, don’t worry. You’re not the only one dreading this. I just want our last meal together to be a happy one. And seeing as Shi-chan definitely won’t be cooking for us, that leaves me.
lines.zh: : 我会的，别担心。不是只有你在害怕这一刻。我只是想让我们最后一餐是快乐的。既然 Shi 酱肯定不会给我们做饭，那就只能我了。

lines.en: : I can help you. I don’t mind at all. I just...can’t guarantee that I don’t have PTSD now since the last time I cooked for you, bad things happened.
lines.zh: : 我可以帮你。我一点都不介意。只是……不能保证我现在没有创伤后应激了，毕竟上次我给你做饭的时候发生了不好的事。

lines.en: : Yeah, maybe just leave the cooking to me and keep Dad company.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那还是把做饭交给我，你去陪爸爸吧。

lines.en: : Himawari.
lines.zh: : Himawari。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds5
: Father.
lines.zh: : 父亲。

lines.en: : I’m sure I can speak for both of us when I say your mother and I would like to do something for {i}you{/i} as well before we have to leave you again.
lines.zh: : 我想我可以代表我们俩说——在你不得不再次离开我们之前，你妈妈和我都想为{i}你{/i}做点什么。

lines.en: : You want to do something for me? Hurry up and uncover all the secrets of this world while I’m out on administrative leave.
lines.zh: : 想为我做点什么？那就趁我停职休假的这段时间，赶紧把这个世界的所有秘密都挖出来。

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. Easy. I’ll get right to that.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。简单。我马上去办。

lines.en: : Hey, I gave you a few hints. You know some of the important bits now, so you’ve just gotta run with it and hope things don’t become even {i}more{/i} unstable.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我已经给了你不少提示了。现在重要的部分你知道了一些，所以你只要顺着往下跑，祈祷事情别变得{i}更{/i}不稳定就行。

lines.en: : Oh god. That sounds like foreshadowing.
lines.zh: : 哦天。这听着像是伏笔。

lines.en: : Wish I could just confirm it. Honestly, what use is time travel at all if I can’t even see the future?
lines.zh: : 我也希望能确认一下。说真的，如果我连未来都看不到，时间旅行到底有什么用？

lines.en: : Call it a prediction, though. Not foreshadowing. Because Maya doesn’t know she’s made-up yet. And who knows what will happen once she does?
lines.zh: : 不过叫它「预测」吧。不是伏笔。因为 Maya 还不知道自己是编出来的。等她知道了会发生什么，谁知道呢？

lines.en: : Which isn’t even factoring in what {i}Ami{/i} is going to do once you tell her the charade’s over.
lines.zh: : 这还没算上你一旦告诉 {i}Ami{/i} 这场戏已经演完了，她会做出什么。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds6

: {size=-2}You...{i}will{/i} tell her the charade’s over, right? Because {i}she’s{/i} your best bet at learning anything right now.  And you can’t keep letting her play house if she’s going to keep ripping the heads off of all of her dolls.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}你……{i}会{/i}告诉她戏已经演完了，对吧？因为{i}她{/i}现在是你最有可能打听到任何消息的人。而且如果她还要继续把那些娃娃的头拧下来，你就不能再让她玩过家家了。{/size}

lines.en: : I know. Ami’s just a little harder to {i}parent{/i} than you are.
lines.zh: : 我知道。Ami 只是比你难{i}管{/i}一点。

lines.en: : Most people are, from what I understand. You guys sure lucked out, huh?
lines.zh: : 据我所知，大多数人都更难管。你们俩算是走了大运，是吧？

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds7
: {i}Luck{/i} doesn’t even begin to explain it, Himawari.
lines.zh: : 「{i}运气{/i}」两个字根本不足以形容，Himawari。

lines.en: : You are more than I could have ever hoped for. And it breaks my heart that you feel the need to do all of this for us when you should be living a normal life.
lines.zh: : 你比我所奢望的还要好得多。而一想到你觉得有必要为我们做这一切，本该过普通生活的你，我就心碎。

lines.en: : So should you, though. And again, you guys have it worse than me. {i}I{/i} can leave. I can see and experience all {i}sorts{/i} of things and all {i}you{/i} guys have is trapped inside this city.
lines.zh: : 可你也该过普通生活啊。再说，你们比我更难。{i}我{/i}能离开。我能看到、经历{i}各种各样{/i}的事，而{i}你们{/i}只有这座困住你们的城市。

lines.en: : It’s fine if everything we have is locked in one place. I learned that in Aomori. And so long as I have that, I don’t {i}need{/i} to experience anything else the world has to offer.
lines.zh: : 就算我们拥有的一切都被锁在一个地方，也没关系。这一点我在 Aomori 学到了。只要有那些，我就{i}不需要{/i}这世界上别的什么了。

lines.en: : I want you. And I promise — no matter {i}which{/i} you it is, I will love you so profoundly that you will have no choice but to forget I ever doubted you at all.
lines.zh: : 我想要你。而且我保证——不管你是{i}哪一个{/i}你，我都会爱得那么深，深到你别无选择，只能忘掉我曾经怀疑过你。

lines.en: : {i}Please...{/i}find a way to come back. Because this can’t {i}really{/i} be the end, right?
lines.zh: : {i}求你……{/i}想办法回来。因为这不可能是{i}真正{/i}的结局，对吧？

lines.en: : You can’t leave {i}now{/i} and just put fate entirely in {i}our{/i} hands. We’ve accomplished nothing. We needed you to break the rules of the universe to just give us a {i}hint.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你不能{i}现在{/i}就走，把命运完全交到{i}我们{/i}手里。我们什么也没做成。我们需要你打破宇宙的规则，就为了给我们一点{i}提示{/i}。

lines.en: : Mom, you’re forgetting one very crucial point.
lines.zh: : 妈妈，你忘了一个非常关键的点。

lines.en: : I exist because of {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我因{i}你们{/i}而存在。

lines.en: : If it weren’t for you guys, I wouldn’t be {i}able{/i} to traverse dimensions and reveal classified info to try and steer you in the right direction.
lines.zh: : 如果不是你们，我根本{i}无法{/i}穿越次元、泄露机密信息，只为试着把你们引向正确的方向。

lines.en: : So all those {i}hints{/i} are only hints at all because you were able to accomplish something amazing on your own.
lines.zh: : 所以那些{i}提示{/i}之所以能成为提示，是因为你们靠自己做到了一件了不起的事。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds8
: And even if it was something as simple as having a daughter and raising her with love, it ultimately led you {i}here.{/i} It led {i}me{/i} here.
lines.zh: : 哪怕那件事简单到只是生了个女儿、用爱把她养大，它最终也把你们带到了{i}这里{/i}。把{i}我{/i}带到了这里。

lines.en: : And it’ll surely lead us back together one day.
lines.zh: : 而它终有一天会把我们重新带到一起。

lines.en: : I wish I could tell you when, but I can’t.
lines.zh: : 我希望我能告诉你们是什么时候，但我不能。

lines.en: : Just know that I’ll be watching. And rooting for you to succeed where I could not.
lines.zh: : 只要知道我会在看着。并且为你们能做到我做不到的事而加油。

lines.en: : Now! Please excuse me while I go dig burger patties out of a McDonald’s freezer. Let’s see if I still remember how to do this.
lines.zh: : 好了！失陪一下，我要去挖 McDonald's 冰柜里的汉堡肉饼了。看看我还记不记得怎么做。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds9
Himawari leaves the two of us at the table, but I’m too distracted by the sound of her footsteps to think much about her speech.
lines.zh: Himawari 留我们两个在桌边，可我被她的脚步声分了神，没法多想她那番话。

lines.en: Because I might never hear them again. That horrible fear that was so prevalent in my happy ending  is now my {i}reality.{/i} Just as I knew it {i}would{/i} be one day.
lines.zh: 因为我可能再也听不到了。那曾在我那个幸福结局里无比鲜明的恐惧，如今成了我的{i}现实{/i}。正如我一直知道它总有一天{i}会{/i}如此。

lines.en: But this isn’t like I’m sending her off to college. We won’t get together for Christmas. She won’t have a family of her own.
lines.zh: 但这不像是送她去上大学。我们不会再聚在一起过圣诞。她也不会有自己的家庭。

lines.en: She’ll be watching me fail from an app and bashing her head against the wall as I squander the massive opportunity she’s given me to finally do {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: 她只能通过一个 app 看着我失败、拿头撞墙，而我却浪费掉她给我的、让我终于能{i}做点什么{/i}的巨大机会。

lines.en: She’s not even {i}gone{/i} yet and I can already feel the old me coming back. I’m so tired of losing the people I love. Now I have to lose {i}her?{/i} That isn’t fair.
lines.zh: 她还没{i}走{/i}，我就已经能感觉到那个旧的自己回来了。我太累了，厌倦了失去我爱的人。现在我还要失去{i}她{/i}？这不公平。

lines.en: If there are so many gods out there helping so many people, why won’t any of them save {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: 如果外面有那么多神在帮那么多人，为什么没有一个愿意救{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: Is it because I haven’t opened my heart? Is {i}that{/i} it?
lines.zh: 是因为我还没有敞开心扉吗？就因为{i}这个{/i}？

lines.en: {size=-2}I opened it to {i}her.{/i} I didn’t {i}want{/i} to and I opened it to her. But I guess it was more like her carving my chest open and splitting it in two with some sort of intangible vice grip instead of a conscious decision {i}I{/i} made.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}我对{i}她{/i}敞开了。我本不{i}想{/i}，可我对她敞开了。但那更像是她用某种无形的老虎钳把我的胸膛撬开、劈成两半，而不是{i}我{/i}有意识做出的决定。{/size}

lines.en: I can’t do that for someone else. Not knowing that {i}she{/i} is still out there.
lines.zh: 我没法对别人做那样的事。在知道{i}她{/i}还在外面的情况下。

lines.en: Ayane is the same. Just like it was the first time we went out to eat with her — when we watched her gorge herself on ikura and mishandle her chopsticks and teach us what family feels like.
lines.zh: Ayane 也一样。就像我们第一次带她出去吃饭时那样——我们看着她大口吞着 ikura、笨拙地摆弄筷子，教会了我们什么叫家人。

lines.en: Neither of us will ever be the same again. We’ll never be {i}normal{/i} again. Assuming we ever {i}were{/i} in the first place.
lines.zh: 我们俩都再也回不去了。我们再也不会「{i}正常{/i}」了。如果我们{i}曾经{/i}正常过的话。

lines.en: But {i}now?{/i} It’s hopeless.
lines.zh: 但{i}现在呢？{/i}毫无希望。

lines.en: How are we supposed to fly without our wings?
lines.zh: 失去了翅膀，我们要怎么飞？

lines.en: I think I might hate the birds too now.
lines.zh: 我想我现在可能也开始恨鸟了。

lines.en: I hate this world. I hate Maya for making it. I hate Ami for selfishly hiding things from me. And I hate myself for hating {i}anything{/i} at all right now instead of using these moments for love.
lines.zh: 我恨这个世界。我恨 Maya 造了它。我恨 Ami 自私地对我隐瞒事情。我也恨我自己——恨我此刻在恨{i}这一切{/i}，而不是把这些时刻用来爱。

lines.en: And I know the fury will fade — just as Himawari will. And as I {i}may{/i} if I can not somehow escape this fate.
lines.zh: 而我知道这份暴怒会消退——就像 Himawari 会淡去一样。就像如果我没法以某种方式逃出这个命运，我自己也{i}可能{/i}会淡去一样。

lines.en: All I can do is hope that the paradox of her existence proves that I’m wrong. And that one day, Ayane {i}will{/i} get to see the look on my face when I first lay eyes on her.
lines.zh: 我唯一能做的，就是祈祷她存在本身的悖论能证明我是错的。祈祷有一天，Ayane {i}能{/i}看到我第一次见到她时脸上的表情。

lines.en: That’s what I must chase now. And simply hope that I can still move forward with my kneecaps bashed in.
lines.zh: 这就是我现在必须去追的东西。然后只能祈祷，在膝盖被砸碎的情况下，我还能继续往前走。

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds10
: Did you...just laugh?
lines.zh: : 你……刚才笑了？

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because {i}you’re{/i} going back to normal too. And it took no time at all.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}你{/i}也变回原样了。而且一点时间都没花。

lines.en: : Four months of “Akira” or “darling” or a million other pet names, but twelve hours back in Kumon-mi and I’m already “Sensei” again.
lines.zh: : 四个月的「Akira」、「亲爱的」，还有一百万个别的昵称，可回到 Kumon-mi 才十二个小时，我又变回「Sensei」了。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds11
: Huh...
: I didn’t even realize...
lines.zh: : 我都没意识到……

lines.en: : What are we going to do, Ayane?...
lines.zh: : 我们该怎么办，Ayane？……

lines.en: : Is she just {i}always{/i} going to be in the back of our minds now? Do we have to do all of this while battling reminder after reminder of what we lost?
lines.zh: : 她是不是从此就{i}永远{/i}盘踞在我们脑海深处了？我们必须一边做这些事，一边不断与失去之物的提醒作战吗？

lines.en: : Because I already see her in {i}everything{/i} and she’s still {i}here.{/i} And when I look at {i}you{/i} and see her eyes, it only makes it worse.
lines.zh: : 因为我已经在{i}一切事物{/i}里看到她了，而她明明还在{i}这儿{/i}。当我看着{i}你{/i}、看到她的眼睛时，只会更糟。

lines.en: : At least you don’t have to look in the mirror. I’m the same way, {i}Akira.{/i} I have no idea how I’m supposed to live now.
lines.zh: : 至少你不用照镜子。我也一样，{i}Akira{/i}。我不知道我该怎么活下去。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds12
: It’s okay if I keep calling you that, right?...
lines.zh: : 我继续这么叫你，没关系吧？……

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t it be?...
lines.zh: : 怎么会没关系？……

lines.en: : Because it’s one more thing that might remind you-
lines.zh: : 因为那是又一件可能会让你想起——

lines.en: : I {i}want{/i} the reminders, though. That’s the worst fucking part. This is a loss I am {i}afraid{/i} to suppress because it’s the first time the goods have ever outweighed the bads.
lines.zh: : 可我{i}想要{/i}这些提醒。这才是最他妈糟的部分。这是一次我{i}害怕{/i}去压抑的失去，因为这是第一次，好的部分压过了坏的部分。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds13
: I’m sorry...I didn’t mean to-
lines.zh: : 对不起……我不是故意——

lines.en: : Don’t apologize...
lines.zh: : 别道歉……

lines.en: : You didn’t do anything wrong. I’m just...lashing out because I’m scared. And every minute that goes by, that fear only deepens.
lines.zh: : 你没做错什么。我只是……因为害怕而在乱发脾气。而每过一分钟，那份恐惧只会更深。

lines.en: : If you want a turn to vent now, go ahead. I imagine we’ll be doing a lot of that from here on out.
lines.zh: : 如果你想轮到发泄了，尽管来。我想我们从今往后会经常这么干。

lines.en: : I’ve already wasted too much time on misery tonight. There’s nothing I want to vent about right now other than how amazing Hima-chan is.
lines.zh: : 今晚我已经在痛苦上浪费了太多时间。现在我唯一想倾诉的，就是 Hima 酱有多了不起。

lines.en: : Once this is over, though...and the world goes back to how it was...
lines.zh: : 不过等这一切结束……等世界变回原样……

lines.en: : I {i}will{/i} need to lean on you. That much I’m sure of. So {i}please,{/i} don’t be the broken one this time.
lines.zh: : 我{i}会{/i}需要依靠你。这点我很确定。所以{i}拜托{/i}，这次别做那个垮掉的人。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : I’m not saying you can’t be sad. I know you love her just as much as I do and that you are terrified right now. But, Akira...
lines.zh: : 我不是说你不能难过。我知道你跟我一样爱她，也知道你现在很害怕。但是，Akira……

lines.en: : This is going to break me.
lines.zh: : 这会把我压垮的。

lines.en: : I just...{i}can’t{/i} do it this time.
lines.zh: : 我只是……这次我{i}做不到{/i}。

lines.en: : And honestly? I don’t think I’ll ever be the same after this.
lines.zh: : 而且说实话？我觉得这之后我再也回不到从前了。

lines.en: : Not until we meet her, at least...After that, I might be able to walk on my own two feet again.
lines.zh: : 至少要等到我们见到她……在那之后，我也许才能重新站起来走路。

lines.en: : But until that happens, please be patient with me...
lines.zh: : 但在那之前，请对我耐心一点……

lines.en: : And please still love me as if I am your wife even though I won’t be...
lines.zh: : 还有，请继续像爱妻子一样爱我，尽管我并不是……

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : I will love you with every fiber of my being and I will carry you when you can’t walk.
lines.zh: : 我会用我存在的每一根纤维去爱你，在你走不动的时候背着你。

lines.en: : So lean on me as much you’d like. But please forgive me if my hands start to shake when I look you in the eyes.
lines.zh: : 所以你想依靠我多久都行。但如果我看着你的眼睛时手开始发抖，请原谅我。

lines.en: : Because I can’t guarantee I won’t be seeing someone else sometimes.
lines.zh: : 因为我不能保证自己有时候不会看到别人。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds14
: Awwwww! You’re so sweet when you try, Dad. I’m so proud of you.
lines.zh: : 哇啊啊！你努力的时候真的很温柔呢，爸爸。我真为你骄傲。

lines.en: : H-Hima-chan! How...much of that did you hear?
lines.zh: : H……Hima 酱！你……听到了多少？

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds15
: Enough to know you guys are being {i}way{/i} too sentimental for what is supposed to be a fun goodbye-dinner.
lines.zh: : 够让我知道，你们对于本该是欢乐告别晚餐的场合来说，实在{i}太{/i}伤感了。

lines.en: : I swear — I leave for five minutes and you guys start acting like I’m {i}already{/i} gone. Now, move over. I’m hungry too.
lines.zh: : 我发誓——我才离开五分钟，你们就开始表现得好像我{i}已经{/i}走了似的。好了，让开点。我也饿了。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds16
: And you — stop looking so sad. Didn’t you hear that Mom’s gonna need you to man up? How are you supposed to do that with a frown that size, huh?
lines.zh: : 还有你——别摆出那副伤心的表情。没听见妈妈说你需要振作起来吗？撇着那么大的嘴，还怎么振作，嗯？

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Himawari. It’s not every day I lose the light of my life and I’m now approaching a {i}second{/i} instance of having to do that in less than twenty-four hours.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Himawari。我并不是每天都会失去生命中的光，而现在不到二十四小时，我就要{i}第二次{/i}经历这种事了。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds17
: Can you believe this guy? He’s got the most beautiful, most loving, and most amazing girlfriend-slash-future-wife anybody could ever want and he’s got the audacity to act {i}gloomy.{/i} The nerve.
lines.zh: : 你们能相信这家伙吗？他拥有任何人能想到的最美丽、最深情、最了不起的女朋友兼未来妻子，居然还好意思摆出一副{i}阴郁{/i}的样子。真是厚脸皮。

lines.en: : Don’t pretend you aren’t proud of him, Hima-chan. He stepped up when I couldn’t. And I think that makes {i}him{/i} pretty amazing too.
lines.zh: : 别装作你不为他骄傲，Hima 酱。在我撑不住的时候，他站了出来。我觉得那也让{i}他{/i}很了不起。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds18
: Great. Thanks, Dad. Now {i}I{/i} look like an asshole for trying to cheer Mom up.
lines.zh: : 好极了。谢了，爸爸。现在我想哄妈妈开心，反倒显得{i}我{/i}像个混蛋。

lines.en: : I’m claiming your second burger. I made you two because I am a good daughter, but now you can just assume I made {i}myself{/i} two because I am a growing girl.
lines.zh: : 你的第二个汉堡我征用了。我给你做了两个是因为我是个好女儿，不过现在你可以理解成我{i}给自己{/i}做了两个，因为我是个正在长身体的女孩。

lines.en: : Yeah...you’re going to {i}keep{/i} growing while your mom and I are off trying to solve what all those gods can’t, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 是啊……你会{i}继续{/i}长大，而你妈妈和我要去试着解决那些神都解决不了的问题，是吧？

lines.en: : I’m afraid that’s classified too, Dad.
lines.zh: : 恐怕那也是机密，爸爸。

lines.en: : I feel like you’re just using the word “classified” to describe things you don’t want to tell me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你只是在用「机密」这个词来指代你不想告诉我的事。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Where’s your proof?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？证据呢？

lines.en: : Don’t have any, right? That’s all speculation then. Good luck having that entered into evidence in the case of Arakawa vs Arakawa. I hope your {i}lawyers{/i} are good.
lines.zh: : 没有吧？那就是全是臆测了。祝你在 Arakawa 诉 Arakawa 一案里把这些作为证据提交顺利。希望你的{i}律师{/i}够厉害。

lines.en: : I’ll miss this...watching the two of you bicker with each other.
lines.zh: : 我会想念这个的……看着你们俩斗嘴。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds19
: Well, {i}somebody’s{/i} gotta. And you two are too busy being a perfect couple to ever fight with one another. The only people willing to put him in his place are Aunt Sana and me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，总得{i}有人{/i}治他。而你们俩忙着做模范情侣，从来不吵架。愿意让他老实点的，只有 Sana 阿姨和我。

lines.en: : Again, please don’t take after her regarding anything ever. You are better than that and I do not want you turning into her.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，任何方面都千万别学她。你比她好，我不想你变成她那样。

lines.en: : What he really means by that is he’s just worried you’ll start being interested in boys.
lines.zh: : 他真正的意思是，他只是担心你开始对男孩子感兴趣。

lines.en: : Ew.
lines.zh: : 恶心。

lines.en: : ...Girls?
lines.zh: : ……女孩子呢？

lines.en: : Ew.
lines.zh: : 恶心。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds20
: Ew...to {i}both{/i} of those things?
lines.zh: : 恶心……这{i}两个都{/i}恶心？

lines.en: : That whole romance thing ain’t for me. I just want a dog.
lines.zh: : 那种恋爱的事不适合我。我只想要一只狗。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re our daughter?
lines.zh: : 你确定你是我们的女儿吗？

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds21
: Besides, not being interested in that stuff gives me more time to wander through time and space! Right, Dad?
lines.zh: : 再说，对那些事没兴趣，我就有更多时间穿越时间和空间了！对吧，爸爸？

lines.en: : Exactly. Now please excuse me while I breathe a sigh of relief so large that I immediately suffocate and die.
lines.zh: : 完全正确。现在请允许我松一口气，大到立刻窒息而死。

lines.en: : Hey, look. The frown is gone.
lines.zh: : 嘿，看。愁眉苦脸没了。

lines.en: : You really {i}were{/i} planning on just staying with us forever then, weren’t you?
lines.zh: : 所以你{i}真的{/i}打算就这么永远跟我们待在一起了，是吧？

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds22
: Mhm! You can call me a loser if you want. That’s what everybody in the office does when I tell them about my dreams.
lines.zh: : 嗯！你想叫我废柴也行。我在办公室跟他们说我的梦想时，他们就是这么叫的。

lines.en: : It doesn’t bother me, though. So a girl loves her family? Big deal. Thinking a dream like that is weird just makes me think none of those people grew up with parents half as cool as mine.
lines.zh: : 不过我不在意。一个女孩爱她的家人，有什么大不了的。觉得这种梦想奇怪，只会让我觉得，那些人的父母都没我的一半酷。

lines.en: : They’re...making fun of you over there?...For just sharing your thoughts with them?
lines.zh: : 他们……在那边取笑你？……就因为你跟他们分享了你的想法？

lines.en: : Some people just don’t understand what ambition looks like. And that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 有些人就是不懂野心长什么样。没关系。

lines.en: : Because {i}I’ll{/i} be the one to change the world while {i}they{/i} keep pushing papers for a soulless company that turned an amazing idea into an unorganized bureaucratic mess.
lines.zh: : 因为改变世界的人{i}会是我{/i}，而{i}他们{/i}会继续为一家毫无灵魂的公司推文件——那家公司把一个了不起的想法变成了一团混乱的官僚烂摊子。

lines.en: : All that matters is I have you guys. So please — make me proud. And create a world in which I can {i}make{/i} my dreams come true.
lines.zh: : 唯一重要的是，我有你们。所以拜托——让我骄傲。去创造一个能让我{i}实现{/i}梦想的世界。

lines.en: : Or at least...the dream I have that I didn’t wind up using my wish on since it played second fiddle to an uneventful NEET life with my parents.
lines.zh: : 或者至少……那个我没把愿望用在它上面的梦想，因为它给「跟爸妈一起过平淡的家里蹲生活」让了路。

lines.en: : So that wish thing...is really true then? That people can make worlds by just {i}wanting{/i} them?
lines.zh: : 那那个愿望的事……是真的了？人们只要{i}想要{/i}，就能造出世界？

lines.en: : Mhm. Or pint-sized nymphomaniacs in Dad’s case. But hey, to each their own.
lines.zh: : 嗯。或者在爸爸的例子里，是个迷你版的色情狂。不过嘛，各有所好。

lines.en: : Have I used mine yet?
lines.zh: : 我已经用过我的了吗？

lines.en: : That’s classified, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 那是机密，Ayane。

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds23
: What a guy. You looking for a job? There might be an opening soon when a certain someone gets canned for having a heart of gold.
lines.zh: : 真有你的。想找工作吗？等某个心地太好的人被炒鱿鱼，可能很快就有空缺了。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’d get along with the gods, to be honest. But I’ll keep it in mind when I get bored from not having anyone to home-school.
lines.zh: : 说实话我觉得我跟那些神处不来。不过等我因为没人可以家教而无聊的时候会考虑的。

lines.en: : Can you really not tell me, Hima-chan?
lines.zh: : 你真的不能告诉我吗，Hima 酱？

lines.en: scene himamcdonalds24
: To be honest, I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我不知道。

lines.en: : You might have. And there might be a world out there where the three of us are eating at McDonald’s for real right now.
lines.zh: : 你也许用过了。也许在某一个世界里，我们三个现在正真真切切地在 McDonald's 吃饭。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s in Aomori. Maybe it’s not. And maybe it doesn’t even exist in the first place. But whatever the case, that’s not important now.
lines.zh: : 也许在 Aomori。也许不在。也许它一开始就根本不存在。但不管怎样，那都不重要。

lines.en: : What’s important is that {i}this{/i} is your reality. Even if it’s just for the time being. And so {i}this{/i} is the place where you need to try your hardest. Because that’s what life is all about, right?
lines.zh: : 重要的是，{i}这{/i}才是你们的现实。哪怕只是暂时的。所以{i}这{/i}就是你们需要拼尽全力的地方。因为人生就是这么回事，对吧？

lines.en: : There’s a lot I still don’t know. About the world. About you guys. Myself too. But every day, I learn. And every day, I grow some more.
lines.zh: : 还有很多我不知道的事。关于世界。关于你们。我自己也是。但每一天我都在学。每一天我都在长大。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: The trick is following the sun. Finding the brightest star in the sky and chasing after it no matter how hot it gets.
lines.zh: : 诀窍是跟着太阳走。在天空中找到最亮的那颗星，然后不管有多热，都追着它跑。

lines.en: : And sure, you might burn up before you ever get there. You probably {i}will.{/i} But that doesn’t mean there’s not someone down below, looking up and rooting for you.
lines.zh: : 当然，你可能在到达之前就烧成灰。大概率{i}会{/i}的。但那不意味着下面没有人仰望你、为你加油。

lines.en: : I hate that we’re worlds apart. But there’s a certain beauty to it too, I think.
lines.zh: : 我讨厌我们相隔世界。不过我觉得，这也有某种美。

lines.en: : Because we’re both chasing after the same thing. And we can both root for each other even if we can’t see one another.
lines.zh: : 因为我们在追逐同一个东西。而且就算看不见彼此，我们也能互相加油。

lines.en: : It’s like when you stare up at the sky and wonder if the person you’re thinking about is doing the same thing. Just less passive and more hopeful because there’s an ending in sight.
lines.zh: : 就像你仰望天空、想知道你想的那个人是不是也在做同样的事。只是不那么被动，更多了些希望，因为看得见终点。

lines.en: : And maybe we’ll wind up there at the same time one day. That, somehow, in that ever-expanding engima we call “space,” we’ll find each other at the end of our mission.
lines.zh: : 也许有一天我们会同时到达那儿。不知怎么地，在我们称之为「太空」的那个不断膨胀的谜团里，我们会在使命的尽头找到彼此。

lines.en: : But instead of being proud of how far we’ve come or confused about what to do next, we’ll just look at each other and smile.
lines.zh: : 但到那时，我们不会为走了多远而骄傲，也不会为接下来该怎么办而迷茫，我们只会看着彼此，然后微笑。

lines.en: scene black
: Then the camera will fade to black.
lines.zh: : 然后镜头淡出到黑。

lines.en: : And we will finally be able to rest.
lines.zh: : 而我们终于可以休息了。
